rubric_items.reason: All 14 acceptance criteria (S-1 AC1-AC5, S-2 AC1-AC4, S-3 AC1-AC5) have at least one test that matches the criterion's given/then.
Counting rules are tested at API integration level and rendering with jsdom unit tests. The one manual test (TP-17, layout) is justified by the strategy's no-browser-tests gap.

Has 404 negatives for GET and PATCH, a 400 negative for POST and a key-set boundary test. Missing: a positive check of the PATCH response's visitSummary, and a test that visitSummary sent in a request body is ignored.

Tools (Vitest, Supertest, fixed clock, Testing Library) and the HMS-5 REQ-n name prefix follow the strategy. No target test files or folders are named, and PatientDetailPage has no existing web test file.
Titles are concrete and runnable. Some 'covers' mappings are stretched, and TP-4's 'clock far later' gives no fixed clock value.
